job.what: First construction of nws-tornado-warning-verification (nws-tornado-build-001), executing the plan pre-registered in the record 2026-11-05 before this launch. Task: for an NWS tornado warning at its issue instant (its own product fields only - issuing WFO, forecaster of record, issue/expire calendar, IBW hail/wind tags, tornado-possible lineage flags, warned county count, storm-based polygon statistics), predict the cow LSR-based verify boolean (>=1 tornado local storm report inside the polygon during the valid window). 17 national TOR year-pulls 2008-2024 from the IEM cow API (measured 20-28 MB / 40-75 s each on the coordinator class; construct streams per year). v1 feature scope = cow per-event fields only; the per-warning product_text/IBW-tag fetch is EXCLUDED on the measured 500-warning sample (500/500 OK, p50 458 ms/1.6 KB -> ~40k fetches >= 61 min at 5 workers, over the 60-min lifetime; decision recorded). Label-source/post-hoc columns (verify, stormreports, stormreports_all, lead0, areaverify, statuses, status, product_text, link) never ship. Hard anchors: 2013 raw features 1832 / verified 441 and 2023 2531 / 656 must reproduce EXACTLY or the build refuses (re-verified EXACT 2026-11-05; the 2023 file changed bytes 28389049->28383984 while counts held - live recomputation). Per-warning fixtures pinned BEFORE launch from 2026-11-05 measurements: Joplin 2011-05-22 SGF #31/#32 verify=1; phantom storm 2022-04-16 LZK #49=1, LZK #50=1, MEG #40=0 (Wolff et al. 2025 arXiv 2510.25011 document all three tornado-emergency warnings as survey false alarms while cow reads 1/1/0 because the false real-time tornado LSrs remain in the LSR archive - the label is report-based, the record's original 'must read verify=false' expectation was corrected to the measured per-warning verdicts before launch). Byte-identical duplicate features are dropped (measured 2013 FWD#33 x2, Joplin #28/#30 x2); same-key disagreeing verify refuses. Splits train 2008-2018 / eval 2019-2021 / holdout 2022-2024; id (year, wfo, eventid) as row_id; event_key = issue date (outbreak-day clustering). quality.json evaluation_contract: use=retrospective_research, access=isolated_rows, vintage=as_of with the current-vintage assumption declared (no historical cow vintages exist), selection=prediction_time (every TOR warning in the window, never outcome-conditioned), training_label_timing=unverified, cross_row_audit with empty probes + rationale (no shipped column aggregates or references another row's outcome; the same-day-earlier-warning exposure lives only in the persistence reference, which is not a shipped column). run.sh fixed order: construct -> full-artifact gate -> exact-byte --accept -> score.py (references on identical eval rows only: majority constant, persistence = most recent earlier same-WFO warning's verify with expiry >= 30 min before issue (declared outcome-availability assumption, train-prior fallback), calendar-only = WFO + doy-bucket + hour train-only logit-additive priors; per-issue-year AUC/Brier and prevalence; day-clustered paired bootstrap). The full model (stock runner) is a separate baseline job per the za-cct/cqc pattern; the pre-registered deciding rule (headroom only if the full model beats EVERY reference on identical eval rows with the day-clustered paired bootstrap 95% CI excluding zero in the model's favour; reference dominance with CI excluding zero on the deficit side -> drop; inconclusive -> hold; no re-tuning after any score) is applied once that number exists.
job.stopping_condition: anchor mismatch, fixture mismatch, duplicate-key verify disagreement, gate failure or empty/one-class eval -> collect diagnostics, diagnose, record; ONE rebuild per structural defect class, a second failure of the same class is a recorded blocker, never a blind retry. A reference-dominance outcome at the baseline stage is a recorded negative finding per the pre-registered rule, not a retry trigger.
